title: From Automation to Co-Creation
content:

So the same for us at Sinuses. And it comes back to three things that at least the customers where I currently work for. What they really want is they want to save time.

They want to avoid mistakes. They want peace of mind that they're avoiding mistakes and they want to keep on improving. They want to know how can I do something better. So saving time, we're talking about no manual form filling. And I'm surprised we're still talking about it because we have AI. We have been talking about UX for a long period of time. We're all pretty good at that and we're still having forms. I thought that the first thing that AI will do is actually solve and and get rid of forms because no one wants to fill me in forms. And the other one is like automated reviews and alerts and how can we do we can save time to just manually check things. And when you check things, how can we make sure that this is actually right? So how can we avoid mistakes? How can we avoid manual data entry? How can we avoid that we don't apply all the rules? These are things that people do want uh and AI could help.
